name: squeeze_release_breakout_001
mechanism: On NIFTY, when Bollinger Bands (2-minute window) compress inside Keltner Channels, institutional algorithms have temporarily suspended directional activity and resting limit orders are stacked symmetrically around a tight range. This equilibrium accumulates directional pressure. When price breaks above the 24-bar rolling high with 90-second and 3-minute EMAs both aligned bullishly and above-average volume participation, algorithmic TWAP/VWAP flow initiates a new directional wave, typically carrying NIFTY 15-25 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds before the next equilibrium forms. The volume surge confirms that institutional orders are actively absorbing supply (or demand) rather than a random spike through the compression range.
core_signal_oneliner: Bollinger Bands compress inside Keltner Channels and price breaks the 2-min range with EMA alignment and volume expansion, releasing the accumulated directional pressure
